welcome.debugToggle: Toggle debug mode (or press and hold the picture for 3 seconds)

requirements.title: Before you start
requirements.intro: We checked your browser. Anything that needs your attention is shown below.
requirements.allGood: Your browser is ready — nothing to do here.

browser.title: This browser won't work
browser.body: Setting up a Blox needs Chrome or Edge, on a computer or an Android phone. Please open this page in one of those.

lna.title: Your browser is blocking access to your network
lna.body: Local network access is needed to reach your Blox.
lna.blocked: This site isn't allowed to reach devices on your network, so it can't find your Blox. Turn it back on at the address below, then reload this page.

camera.title: Camera
camera.optional: Only needed if you want to scan a pairing QR code. You can always type the code instead.
camera.refused: Your browser didn't allow it. You can still type the pairing code instead, or turn the camera on later in your browser's site settings.

linkPassword.walletUnavailable: The wallet module could not be loaded. You can still sign manually.
linkPassword.clearAppStorageWebMessage: This deletes everything FxBlox stored in this browser — identity, Blox list, settings and caches — and reloads the page.
linkPassword.clearAppStorageFailed: Could not clear the app storage
linkPassword.signaturePortalHint: Sign at fxblox.fx.land, then paste the signature below together with the wallet address you signed with.

connectToBlox.intro: Turn your Blox on, then connect to it with Bluetooth. We'll suggest other ways if that doesn't work.

lan.title: Is your Blox connected to your home network?
lan.body: If you've plugged your Blox into your router with a cable, or it's already on your Wi-Fi, you can connect to it directly. You'll find its address in your router's list of connected devices — it usually starts with 192.168.
lan.badAddress: That doesn't look like a home network address. It should start with 192.168, 10. or 172.
lan.notFound: No Blox answered at that address. Check the address, or use the Blox's own Wi-Fi instead.

connectToBlox.hotspotCheck: I've joined the FxBlox Wi-Fi — check
connectToBlox.hotspotJoin: Open your Wi-Fi settings and join the network called "FxBlox", then come back and press the button below. Your internet will pause while you're connected to it.
connectToBlox.lnaExplainer: Chrome will ask to allow this site to access devices on your local network. Choose Allow.
connectToBlox.checkingHotspot: Checking the hotspot… we keep checking every few seconds.
connectToBlox.bleChooserHint: Chrome's device chooser opens — pick "fulatower" or "fxblox" and click Pair.
connectToBlox.bleUnavailable: Web Bluetooth is not available in this browser.
connectToBlox.connectionErrorMessage: Could not reach the Blox. Make sure you are connected to the FxBlox hotspot and try again.

error.lnaDeniedBody: Chrome is blocking this site from talking to your Blox. Open the address below, allow this site, then try again.
error.corsTitle: Blox firmware needs an update for browser access
error.corsBody: The Blox answered, but its firmware predates the web update (missing CORS headers). Use "Connect via Bluetooth" to continue, or update the Blox from the mobile app.
error.unreachableBody: Make sure this device is connected to the Wi-Fi network "FxBlox" (not your home network) and that the Blox is powered on.
error.timeoutTitle: The Blox did not answer in time
error.timeoutBody: The Blox may still be booting. Wait for the light-blue LED and try again.
error.lnaActionHint: Your browser has not been allowed to reach devices on your local network yet. That permission is required to talk to the Blox over Wi-Fi.
error.lnaNoPrompt: Your browser did not show a permission dialog. Allow this site's local network access in site settings, then try again.
error.openSettings: Copy this address and paste it into Chrome's address bar:

connectToExistingBlox.noDevices: No devices found. Make sure your Blox is powered on and connected to the same network.
connectToExistingBlox.webScanHint: The browser cannot discover devices by itself: the scan checks the FxBlox hotspot, addresses this app has seen before and the ones the discovery service reports for your Bloxs. If your Blox is not listed, add it by IP address.
connectToExistingBlox.enterIpAddress: Enter the IP address of your Fula Node
connectToExistingBlox.invalidIp: Enter a private network address (for example 192.168.1.100).
connectToExistingBlox.bleScanFailed: Could not read the Blox over Bluetooth

setBloxAuthorizer.manualHint: Enter the peer ID of the Blox you want to add (shown in the mobile app or on the Blox itself).

connectToWifi.listError: Could not read the Wi-Fi list from the Blox.
connectToWifi.bloxSideHint: These are the networks your Blox can see.

password.title: Enter password for "{{ssid}}"
password.countryCodeHint: Two-letter Wi-Fi regulatory country (for example CA, US, DE).

checkConnection.title: Reconnect to your Blox
checkConnection.instructions: Your Blox is joining "{{ssid}}". Its FxBlox hotspot switches off as soon as it connects.
checkConnection.step1: If the "FxBlox" hotspot is still visible, stay connected to it.
checkConnection.step2: Otherwise join "{{ssid}}" — the same network as the Blox.
checkConnection.apDisableFailed: Could not turn off the hotspot; it switches off by itself once the Blox is online.

setupComplete.keepTabOpen: Keep this tab open while the Blox connects.

bluetoothCommands.title: Bluetooth commands
bluetoothCommands.notConnected: Click the plug icon in the top right corner to connect to your FxBlox device using Bluetooth
bluetoothCommands.hint: Click on this icon to connect to your FxBlox and after connection you will see the available commands
bluetoothCommands.connectFailed: Failed to connect to Blox device
bluetoothCommands.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to execute {{label}}?
bluetoothCommands.codePrompt: Enter the code given to you by the support team
bluetoothCommands.invalidCodeMessage: Please enter the correct code provided by support team
bluetoothCommands.logsTitle: Share the logs below with support team by clicking on the copy icon
